conversation_starters.title: City Council approves $60 million purchase of land for new Spurs arena and OKs Midtown TIRZ extension—with a catch
conversation_starters.summary: San Antonio leaders approved extending the Midtown TIRZ, a tax increment reinvestment zone that sets aside growth in property tax dollars to pay for projects inside that area, to 2060, though Councilman Edward Mungia led a change that gives leaders flexibility in sunsetting it early.
questions: Have you been following the plans for the new Spurs arena?
What are people around San Antonio saying about what the arena would mean for the Midtown area?
